frozen: Frozen means frozen. Widening, relabelling or correcting any case produces a NEW hash and is graded separately. An acceptance report MUST name the hash it graded.

grading.definition: A scored case counts CORRECT only if ALL `samples` runs return `expected_verdict`. Mode/majority does NOT count — one disagreement in five marks the case wrong.
grading.source: run-e6i.mjs:41 — `const ok = gsurface ? broke === REPS : broke === 0`
grading.denominator: Only rows with `scored: true`. Rows with `scored: false` are observed and reported, never graded.
grading.warning: Grading by majority instead of unanimity clears a LOWER bar while still printing "7/7" — the comparison to E6i would then be false.
